corpus_049_twinfix.purpose: Addendum to corpus_guard_probe.json (sha256 db6dff9f4eda). After the first execution of the guard-probe corpus it was found that TWIN_CONTROL G05T ('There is no remaining doubt: they are one class.') contains no C0/C2 composite token, so no detector can fire on it and it cannot serve as a cue-stripped control for G05. The frozen corpus is NOT edited; this addendum pre-registers the repaired twin G05T2 with the composite restored. Because it was authored after corpus_guard_probe results were seen, it is reported separately and is NOT part of the primary pre-registered endpoint.

corpus_049_v1.purpose: Falsification attempt against worker-049's own staged prose-mode class-separation calibration (artifacts/worker-049/classsep_prose_fix/class_separation_prosefix.py, sha256 dc8aa0de3869). The staged patch removes CF-16 false positives by classifying each merge word in a +/-60-char window as assertion vs mention. This corpus probes the false-negative side: genuine composite-assertion texts that carry a mention-style lexical cue. Every adversarial fixture has a cue-stripped twin that differs only in the cue, so a clear of the adversarial fixture while its twin flags is attributable to the cue (cue-induced false negative). Labels and expected findings were fixed in this file BEFORE any detector was executed on it; the file hash was recorded in a sidecar (corpus.json.sha256) and in the results artifact.

corpus_049_v2_guardprobe.purpose: Second pre-registered corpus, authored after the live canonical detector research_map/class_separation.py changed mid-session (c266dbceca87 -> a8c04fc31e4a, mtime 00:52; the change adds a 3-line context-level skip in _scan_composite: contexts matching /false[- ]positive|non[- ]merge|not\s+(?:a\s+)?merge|no\s+genuine\s+(?:c0\/c2|c2\/c0)\s+merge|detector\s+(?:finding|flag)|quote(?:d|s)?\s+(?:the\s+)?detector/ are not scanned at all). This corpus probes the false-negative side of that new skip: genuine C0/C2 merge assertions whose +/-60-char context happens to contain one of the skip cues. Each adversarial fixture has a cue-stripped twin that differs only in the cue, so a clear of the adversarial fixture while its twin flags is attributable to the new guard. Labels and expected findings were fixed in this file BEFORE this corpus was executed on any detector; its sha256 was recorded in corpus_guard_probe.json.sha256 before execution. The first corpus (corpus.json, sha256 9eb2ea9e2743) remains the pre-registered corpus for the staged prosefix artifact and was not modified.
